subject.title: [Bug]: Google Chat: Space/Group messages silently ignored (DMs work correctly)

question: What should Google Chat Spaces use as the app-activation rule when Google delivers a Space event but the current `USER_MENTION` target matching does not mark `wasMentioned` true?
rationale: Source inspection proves the skip path, but choosing whether to loosen Google Chat mention activation, require stricter `botUser` matching, or consolidate this with broader Space routing needs maintainer intent because it affects group trigger authorization.

options.title: Repair Strict Mention Detection
options.body: Collect or accept redacted live annotation proof, update Google Chat app-target matching and diagnostics, and keep the group mention gate target-specific.

options.title: Consolidate Space Routing Work
options.body: Move the remaining requirement into a broader Google Chat Space/thread routing plan if maintainers want one canonical item for all Space metadata preservation.

options.title: Loosen Space Mention Activation
options.body: Treat any delivered Google Chat Space mention event as sufficient activation, reducing false drops but accepting a broader group-trigger rule.

recommendation.title: Repair Strict Mention Detection
recommendation.body: Collect or accept redacted live annotation proof, update Google Chat app-target matching and diagnostics, and keep the group mention gate target-specific.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current history is on Google Chat access-policy and shared mention-gating code, which is where this product/security boundary lives.
